description: A UNION, IF and GREATEST over a signed and an unsigned integer, a BIGINT and a BIGINT UNSIGNED, and an integer and text read every row: the signed and unsigned pair as the wider signed integer, the two 64-bit ones as a DECIMAL and the integer and text as text, as the server types them. AVG of a DECIMAL and of an integer reads as a DECIMAL and SUM of a FLOAT as a DOUBLE.
